description: Capability set for the pre-rendered, non-activating idea-board capture overlay window (hq-idea-board US-003). Receives capture-overlay:shown / capture-overlay:hidden via core:event; invokes the app commands capture_overlay_ready and dismiss_capture_overlay (custom commands need no per-command tokens). The window never calls core window commands itself — show/hide/position are driven from Rust on chord press and Escape.
